decisions.statement: A generator stating this answers here rather than in the code running it.
What a change could turn is read from the names of the paths that change has.
A change naming a page type could turn a type.
A change naming a generator or a type file could turn a type.
A change naming a page a generated type sits beside could turn a type.
A path a generated body imports could turn a type whether the change writes or takes it.
Which bodies import that path is read beside the page before the change rather than the shadow.
That reading is taken only where the names of the changed paths answered nothing.
Nothing here writes a type or reaches a generator.

definition: whether a change could turn the type written beside a page
